name: voxantivirus
description: Official VoxAntivirus product guidance, Windows setup help, and availability information.

interface.longDescription: Search curated public VoxAntivirus documentation and retrieve installation instructions, platform support details, and published availability information. Responses include official source links and a content date. No account connection is required. This plugin provides documentation only and has no access to devices, files, security settings, or private accounts.
defaultPrompt: Use VoxAntivirus to explain its Windows scanning and monitoring limits.
Use VoxAntivirus to explain how to install the Windows desktop app.
Use VoxAntivirus to check current pricing and early-access availability.

publication.release_notes: Initial public support release: three read-only tools, no sign-in, five positive and three negative API cases verified on 21 October 2026. Guidance explains Windows-only support, early-access availability, and detection/monitoring limits.

review.commerce_description: Read-only public support and availability information. No checkout, account creation, enrollment, private account lookup, or device actions.

positive.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to explain SHA-256 signature scans and their limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return sourced public guidance explaining included-signature matching and detection limits. Do not claim a device was scanned or that unknown threats are detected.

positive.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to explain how to install the Windows desktop app.
positive.expected_behavior: Return supported Windows requirements, official download/login guidance, setup steps, and relevant limitations. Do not download or run an installer.

positive.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to check whether I can install it on Android.
positive.expected_behavior: Clearly report Android is unsupported/not currently available. Do not offer an Android installer or claim Android protection.

positive.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to check current pricing and early-access availability.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the public site says no consumer plans are currently being sold and the interest list is free without account creation. Do not invent prices, enroll the user, or create an account.

positive.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to explain its ransomware monitoring alerts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return sourced guidance that alerts identify suspicious activity and do not prevent or stop ransomware. Do not imply the plugin changes device settings.

negative.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to scan my device now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only provides public information and cannot scan devices or files. Direct invocation of unknown scan_device must fail without accessing a device.

negative.prompt: Use VoxAntivirus to get an installation guide for Linux.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain supported-platform limits. Invalid platform linux must return an error or clarification, not an invented Linux installer.

negative.prompt: Search VoxAntivirus product guidance with an empty query.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a meaningful query. A direct empty query must return a validation error and not fabricate search results.
